# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old  <sub>[v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v3 c21 P13](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0013)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P16](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0016), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 c21 P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Queen Nell  <sub>[v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Anne; Nell with an E  <sub>[v1 c12 P17](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0017)</sub>; Tall Nell; Nell of Grey Shutters; Nell-girl

## Appearance

Nell has gray eyes, red hair, and a fair complexion. She is tall in stature with distinct facial features, though she has occasionally struggled with freckles on her nose.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 c20 P17](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0017), [v3 c21 P9](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0009), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003)_

## Personality

Nell possesses an imaginative, romantic, and high-principled nature. Possessing a strong sense of humor, she is deeply affectionate toward her close friends and caretakers. She demonstrates determination once her mind is set on a project, though she can occasionally be prone to dramatic moments over her personal flaws.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011), [v1 c27 P22](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0022), [v2 c1 P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

Nell was born in a small yellow house in Harborough, Nova Scotia. After losing both of her parents to fever during infancy, she was cared for by guardians and spent time in an asylum until she was eleven years old. She was taken in by Thirza and Obed Abernethy of Grey Shutters in Brierley, avoiding being sent to live with Mrs. Scobie. Upon arriving in Brierley, she formed a lifelong friendship with Isolde Pembroke, swearing a mutual vow of friendship in the Pembrokes' garden. In her youth, Nell attempted to dye her red hair, which disastrously turned green, and made various attempts to erase her freckles. She trained as a schoolteacher at Regent's and later accepted a position as a rural schoolma'am at Coombe Road, staying with Thora Sweet at Wayside. She actively advocated for local community enhancements, co-founding the Brierley Village Improvement Society alongside Hugh Carrow. In adulthood, she married Dr. Hugh Carrow and moved to Seven Gulls.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P16](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0016), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P25](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P20](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0020), [v2 c1 P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c20 P19](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0019), [v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 c21 P7](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0007), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_
